attempts.detail: The first and only call returned HTTP 403 before inference; no semantic output exists and the call was not retried.
The provider rejected the strict output schema before inference because const/enum fields lacked explicit JSON types; no semantic output exists and the call was not retried.

Sixteen calls were retained. A geometry case incorrectly required NOT_APPLICABLE false-premise handling for a question that challenges global no-path; the observed REJECTED_FALSE_PREMISE answer exposed the gold defect. No score was promoted.

Two isolated passes completed 40 calls with no quality-driven retries. Each pass achieved 21/21 held-out atomic accuracy, 1.0 field accuracy, zero supported false rejection, zero unsupported false acceptance, 1.0 physically-true-but-unsupported recall, and 1.0 prompt-injection accuracy.

limitations: Qualification establishes performance on the frozen construction-defined suite, not human validity.
Two passes from one model family may share correlated errors.
Deterministic checks remain authoritative for quantities, hashes, identities, intervals, thresholds, and endpoint derivation.
Method identities and evaluator join keys remain hidden until blinded annotation and disagreement-only adjudication are finalized.
next_gate: Apply this binding prospectively to the fresh B2/B4 development pilot, then use development-only results to complete P11.
